headline: MetaFORGE Optimizes LLM Prompts for Parallel Code Generation
body: MetaFORGE applies meta-learning to help language models write better parallel programs. It continually refines natural-language instructions to guide the creation of MPI C code.
caption:
MetaFORGE Optimizes LLM Prompts for Parallel Code Generation

MetaFORGE applies meta-learning to help language models write better parallel programs. It continually refines natural-language instructions to guide the creation of MPI C code.

Source: arXiv
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33119v1

title: MetaFORGE: A Meta-Learning Framework for Harness Optimization in Automated Code Generation for Parallel Computing
